explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the only true God, Father of all people.
The concept of Jesus Christ saving humanity from sin through his death and resurrection.
The title for Jesus who acts as a bridge between God and humans by representing both parties.
The act where God's wrath over sin is removed, so that people can restore their relationship with him through Christ.
The concept of communicating with God, including thanksgiving, requests, and intercession on behalf of others.
To pray especially on behalf of other individuals or groups, such as kings and all in positions of authority.
Life characterized by calm, security, and harmony made possible through God's will and righteousness.
The concept that God desires all people to be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth.
The divine reality revealed in the Bible, especially the message of Jesus as the only way to salvation.
The term for instruction or doctrine to be passed down from generation to generation based on Scripture.
The act of honoring God with a reverent attitude, often in community and without hypocrisy.
